title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Same-Day Instant Transfer Velocity Share
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — velocity share on instant transfers to an external debit card.**

The velocity share multiplies the instant transfer amount by **70 percent** when two or more instant transfers are already booked on the plan today or the instant transfers already booked today total **300.00** or more, by **85 percent** when exactly one is booked and it totals less than 300.00, and in full when none is.

The transfers read are the plan's instant transfers, to any destination, already booked today, returned or not.

| Instant transfers already booked today | Their total | Share |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | in full |
| exactly 1 | less than 300.00 USD | 85 percent |
| exactly 1 | 300.00 USD or more | 70 percent |
| 2 or more | any | 70 percent |

*Hypothetical:* after one instant transfer of 120.00 USD today, the share is 85 percent; after one of 300.00 USD, 70 percent; after two of 45.50 USD each, 70 percent.
